title: Camper Rental Booking Engine
description: A self-serve camper rental site for browsing vehicles, checking dates, and moving from interest to reservation quickly.
problem: Rental demand needed a clearer path from browsing to booking.
system: Inventory, dates, offer framing, and reservation CTA in one front-end flow.
artifact: Responsive booking website with vehicle cards and search entry point.
outcome: A manual inquiry motion becomes a productized booking experience.
